properties.notes: The site comprises Polhill Business Centre containing serviced offices, a residential dwelling, a restaurant, and mixed B2/B8 storage and workshop buildings with associated hardstanding for lorry parking. Bounded by the Calcutta Club Indian restaurant to the north, woodland and open countryside to the east and south, and London Road to the west.
